set.body: Clarify StoryAtlas's local no-view-side-inference rule after the chief-approved SurfaceUnit contract. Preserve the ban on scientific inference and semantic coordinates, while explicitly permitting a renderer to assign layout-only device placement when the provider contract declares that the mark has no projection coordinate and that the placement carries no position or distance meaning. One documentation path only; no code or provider changes.
set.title: Clarify layout-only placement under the no-inference law
